paragraphs.text: Vram was a planeswalker who put her daughter Mao under the wing of the naturalist Peter Langwynd .

Initially, Vram appeared in a male form, but she was later revealed to be one of the Dobéhma , a women-only race with lilac-colored hair. She possessed the ability to alter the seasons. While visiting Langwynd to procure a big swamp frog for her battles, she was attacked by another planeswalker and accidentally blew up the Foulmere Swamp. This act flung her away through the multiverse , abandoning her cat, Mao, who turned out to be her daughter under a shapeshifting spell.
